question: Can we accept the independently checked reruns as replacements for the historical mining and diagnosis runs whose original proofs/models were not saved? The reruns passed, but we cannot prove their outputs match the lost originals. Completed results from the fresh fuzz campaigns were independently checked. I recommend accepting the reruns, while permanently documenting that limitation. With your agreement, I can finish the final acceptance report and handoff.
preserved_limitations: Original artifacts were never independently checked or retained.
No retained original proof/model fingerprint proves equality to checked reruns.
Original d1/d2 in-job pin/checker/snapshot gates remain absent; terminal postflight does not invent historical checks.
Frozen strict NOT ACCEPTED reports and all earlier negative evidence are preserved.
does_not_change: Fresh minimum100000 per policy, independent completed-run proof/model oracles and effective coverage requirements.
Four default regression gates and checker censoring/cost contract.
No scalar reward/learning, fallback, rollback, forced resumption or global loop budget.
